name: TelegramFileServer
description: Your files, in Telegram. Served as your own cloud drive. Rust + Axum server with a React web UI, MongoDB metadata, Telegram storage.

HOST.description: Bind address. Heroku only routes traffic to processes bound to 0.0.0.0 — leave this value as is.

TFS_MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB (Atlas) connection string. Must be the same URI the setup wizard's step 1 uses. Survives dyno restarts and rebuilds — the container filesystem is wiped on every deploy.

TFS_WIZARD_PASSWORD.description: Setup wizard password (8+ characters). It encrypts the Telegram credentials stored in MongoDB and must match the password entered in the wizard's step 1.
